name: Kusurinomadoguchi,Inc.
summary: Kusurinomadoguchi, Inc., formed in 2004 with headquarters in Tokyo, Japan, develops and implements technology solutions for pharmacies and the medical care sector. Its patient-facing services include the EPARK drug counter, an online portal where people find pharmacies and book appointments, and the EPARK medicine notebook for digital management of family prescriptions. It also offers a clinic management system and a Pharmacy Support service.
